notes: The verbless identification הוּא פַרְעֹה puts is on the written predicate and leaves This to the pronoun (rule 20); no repeated determiner is written, so rule 20's identifying-formula clause does not engage.
Both אֶת tokens here are the preposition with (H854), matching their R tagging, and each takes the written with.
אֶל takes the written To at the verse's head, in contrast with 31.2 where the ASV writes no word for it.
